description: This file contains utility functions for coercing form input string values into their appropriate JSON schema types (number, boolean, object, array) within a form handling context. It includes functions for coercing number and boolean strings, and a main exported function 'coerceFormValues' that recursively processes form data according to a JSON schema.

methods.name: coerceNumberString
methods.description: Converts a string to a number or returns undefined if the string is empty or invalid.

methods.name: coerceBooleanString
methods.description: Converts a string 'true'/'false' to boolean, or returns the original string if not matching.

methods.name: coerceFormValues
methods.description: Recursively walks a form value tree alongside its JSON schema to coerce string values into their schema-defined types (number, boolean, object, array).
